title: Signed grip-trial drift does not improve cross-cycle HbA1c prediction beyond strength summaries
abstract: In 4,400 NHANES 2011–2012 complete-case adults and 4,890 separately sampled 2013–2014 adults, signed bilateral grip-trial drift did not convincingly improve concurrent HbA1c prediction beyond standard strength, anthropometry, demographics and order-invariant grip summaries. Target weighted MSE changed +0.00012317 (+0.0166%), conditional95% PSU bootstrap [−0.00060627,+0.00090536], source-plus-target refit95% [−0.00074832,+0.00158109]; source grouped-CV also worsened. This limits one linear trial-direction feature, not all endurance or glycemic-state information.
